UNITED STATES ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION AGENCY
REGION VI 1600 PATTERSON DALLAS, TEXAS 7520!
April 14, 1976
Mr. Gordon A. Walhood Chief, Engineering Division Fort Worth District, Corps of Engineers P. O. Box 17300 Fort Worth, Texas 76102
Dear Mr. Walhood:
This is in reply to your letter of March 16, 1976 concerning the proposal by the International Boundary and Water Commission to install hydroelectric generators to the Amistad Lake project on the Rio Grande River. The Environmental Protection Agency does not have any specific land use plans in the Del Rio, Texas area; however, we have granted funds for wastewater treatment facilities which are currently under construction in the City of Del Rio.
If we can be of further assistance, please contact us.
Sincerely yours,
Clinton B. Spotts
Regional EIS Coordinator
